subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and let managed `web_search` implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, tests, docs, and the shipped policy PR require explicit selection for key-free providers, while the requested fix changes an outbound provider-routing and data-sharing default.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Leave key-free providers explicit and handle confusion through cron diagnostics, setup copy, or doctor guidance.

options.title: Approve full keyless fallback
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only with aligned runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the candidate PR
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not merge the candidate branch until a maintainer-owned policy decision is recorded.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Leave key-free providers explicit and handle confusion through cron diagnostics, setup copy, or doctor guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy this issue asks to reverse.
